title: Cinder Bloom: A Tequila Cocktail With Passion Fruit and Peppers
ldName: Cinder Bloom: A Tequila Cocktail With Passion Fruit and Peppers
ldInstructionsRaw: Place 4 ají dulce peppers in a shaker and muddle. Add the rest of the ingredients along with ice. Shake hard for about 5 seconds, or until the outside of the shaker is frosty. Strain into the glass over ice.
